annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that a client expand the payload of any UDP datagram carrying Initial packets to at least 1200 bytes, and it specifies two valid methods (adding PADDING frames or coalescing the Initial packet). The reference to [packet-coalesce] clarifies the coalescing method. No alternative materially different interpretations or missing constraints are present.
